title: bgvars: Bayesian Inference of Global Vector Autoregressive and Global Vector Error Correction Models
description: An R package that assists in the set-up and inference of Bayesian global vector autoregressive (BGVAR) and global vector error correction (BGVEC) models. It covers the preparation of country-specific data and weight matrices, the specification and estimation of country sub-models, their combination into a solved global model, and the evaluation of the result by means of forecasts, generalised impulse responses and forecast error variance decompositions.
